z-m-20-01.title: Ingabe isamba sezinkulumo ezimbili ze-quadratic sihlala siyinkulumo ye-quadratic?
z-m-20-01.goal: Chaza ukuthi izinga lishintsha kanjani esambeni nasemphumeleni wama-polynomial, uhlukanisa amacala ngezibonelo eziphikisayo nezizathu.
z-m-20-01.material: Ama-polynomial A no-B bobabili ayizisho ze-quadratic ku-x. Okusho ukuthi i-coefficient ye-x² ayingu-0 (fundwa: x² ingu-"x squared"), futhi onke ama-coefficient ayizinombolo zangempela. Izinga lingu-izinga lethemu eliphezulu elingu-coefficient yalo ayingu-0. Isibonelo, x²+3x isisho se-quadratic futhi u-2 unezinga elingu-0. Ngeke sicabange ngecala lapho u-A+B noma u-A−B kungu-0 ngokwawo. U-Seoyeon uthe, "Uma wengeza izisho ze-quadratic, uthola isisho se-quadratic, futhi uma uziphindaphinda, uthola isisho sezinga lesi-4."
z-m-20-01.thinking.1: Qhathanisa isamba nomphumela bese ucabanga ukuthi yimuphi ongalahlekelwa ithemu lawo eliphezulu
z-m-20-01.prereq.0: I-H1 kulo msebenzi imaka kuphela ubunzima nezinga losizo lalesi sethi sokukhiqiza; akusona isikhundla sebanga ekharikhulamu. Cabanga ukuthi uyazi ukwengeza, ukukhipha nokuphindaphinda kwama-polynomial esikole esiphakathi, amafomula okuphindaphinda, nokwenza ama-factor okuyisisekelo.
z-m-20-01.prereq.2: Umphumela wezinombolo ezimbili ezingeyona u-0 awungu-0
z-m-20-01.s.s1.prompt: Uma u-A no-B bezisho ze-quadratic ezanelisa isimo esingenhla, khetha zonke izitatimende ezihlala ziyiqiniso noma yiziphi izisho ezimbili ze-quadratic ozikhethayo.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.hint.0: Uma isitatimende sihlala siyiqiniso, kumele sisebenze kunoma yiliphi ipheya lezisho ze-quadratic oluyifaka. Khetha izisho ezimbili ze-quadratic ezilula, uzengeze futhi uziphindaphinde, bese uhlola izinga.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kusitatimende ngasinye, zama ukukhetha u-A no-B abenza leso sitatimende siphuthe, futhi uma ungakwazi ukubakhetha, bhala ukuthi kungani ungakwazi.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.a: Usho "njalo" ngaphandle kokuhlola icala lapho isamba sama-coefficient ka-x² singu-0.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.b: Lesi sinqumo sibona ukuthi ukwengeza kwengeza kuphela ama-coefficient amathemu ezinga elifanayo, ngakho akuvelanga ithemu elisha eliphezulu.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.c: Lesi sinqumo sicabanga ukuthi yimaphi amathemu amabili aphindaphindwayo enza ithemu eliphezulu lomphumela.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.d: Ucabange ukuthi ithemu eliphezulu liyanyamalala uma ukhipha. Liyanyamalala kuphela uma ama-coefficient amabili ka-x² elingana. Isibonelo, uma A=x² no-B=2x², khona A−B=−x².
z-m-20-01.s.s1.o.e: I-coefficient yethemu le-x⁴ ku-A×B ingaba ngu-0.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.e: Uthathele umphumela osesambeni njengoba unjalo. Cabanga ukuthi i-coefficient yethemu eliphezulu lomphumela yenziwa kanjani.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.explain: b no-c kusebenza kunoma yiliphi ipheya lezisho ze-quadratic. a iyaphuka uma isamba sama-coefficient amabili ka-x² singu-0, futhi d iyaphuka uma ama-coefficient amabili ka-x² ehluka. Ukuthi kungani e ingasebenzi uzokuchaza wena esinyathelweni sokugcina.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.prompt: Vumela A=ax²+bx+1 no-B=cx²+dx+2 (a, b, c, d izinombolo zangempela). Yenza izibonelo ezimbili ezinezisho ezihlukile lapho bobabili u-A no-B bezisho ze-quadratic kodwa u-A+B engeyona isisho se-quadratic.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuthi i-coefficient yethemu le-x² ku-A+B ingavezwa kanjani usebenzisa u-a no-c.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha u-a ukuze le coefficient ibe ngu-0 bese ufanisa u-c nayo. Bese ukhetha b no-d ngokukhululeka futhi wengeze ukuhlola.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Uma i-coefficient ka-x² a ka-A ingu-0, khona u-A akayona isisho se-quadratic.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Uma i-coefficient ka-x² c ka-B ingu-0, khona u-B akayona isisho se-quadratic.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Lisekhona ithemu le-x² ku-A+B. Thola i-coefficient ka-x² ye-A+B bese uhlola.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, uma A=x²+2x+1 no-B=−x²+5x+2, khona A+B=7x+3, okuyisisho se-linear. Uma A=2x²+3x+1 no-B=−2x²+3x+2, khona A+B=6x+3. Zombili izisho ziyi-quadratic, kodwa uma isamba sama-coefficient ka-x² singu-0, isamba asiyona isisho se-quadratic. Ngakho "ukwengeza izisho ze-quadratic kunikeza isisho se-quadratic" akulungile njalo.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.prompt: Phakathi kwezicelo zika-Seoyeon, "ukwengeza kunikeza isisho se-quadratic" kwaphuka, kodwa "ukuphindaphinda kunikeza isisho sezinga lesi-4" akuzange kuphuke. Bhala ngamagama akho ukuthi kungani ithemu eliphezulu lingeke linyamalale emphumeleni, uqhathanisa nesamba.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.hint.0: Thola ukuthi yiliphi ithemu lika-A neliphi ithemu lika-B okumele liphindaphindwe ukwenza ithemu le-x⁴ ku-A×B.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.hint.1: I-coefficient ka-x² ye-A+B ngu-a+c. Bhala ukuthi i-coefficient ka-x⁴ ye-A×B ivela kanjani, bese uqhathanisa kokubili.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ngamagama akho ukuthi kungani ithemu eliphezulu lingaphela esambeni (ama-coefficient ahlangana abe ngu-0)?
z-m-20-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale ukuthi yimaphi amathemu amabili aphindaphindwayo enza ithemu eliphezulu lomphumela?
z-m-20-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi umphumela wezinombolo ezimbili ezingeyona u-0 awungu-0 njengesizathu?
z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.0: Esambeni, sengeza ama-coefficient ka-x², futhi a+c ingaba ngu-0, ngakho ithemu le-x² lingaphela. Emphumeleni, i-coefficient yethemu eliphezulu ngu-ac, umphumela ka-a no-c. Uma u-a no-c bobabili bengeyona u-0, ac nayo ayingu-0, ngakho ithemu le-x⁴ lihlala njalo.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.1: Uma siphindaphinda, umphumela wamathemu aphezulu uyithemu le-x⁴, futhi yilowo kuphela umphumela owenza ithemu le-x⁴, ngakho akukho elinye ithemu elilikhansela. I-coefficient nayo ingumphumela wezinombolo ezingeyona u-0, ngakho ayingu-0. Esambeni, + no-− bangahlangana benze u-0, ngakho ithemu lingaphela, kodwa lokho akunakwenzeka emphumeleni.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.2: Isibonelo, ku-(x²+1)(−x²+2), igama elilodwa le-x⁴ yi-x²×(−x²)=−x⁴, ne-coefficient yalo −1 ayiyona 0, ngakho iyinkulumo yedigri 4. Esambeni (x²+1)+(−x²+2), i-coefficient ye-x² ingu-1+(−1)=0, ngakho igama le-x² lanyamalala.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Impendulo echazwe ngezinkulumo ezithile nayo ilungile.

z-m-20-02.title: Iyiphi inkulumo enenani elimiswe yisamba kuphela?
z-m-20-02.topic: Amafomula okuphindaphinda namanani ezinkulumo: izinombolo ezimbili ezinesamba esinikeziwe
z-m-20-02.goal: Nquma ukuthi iyiphi inkulumo enenani elilodwa uma kuphela isamba a+b sezinombolo ezimbili saziwa, bese uhlukanisa ulwazi olwengeziwe olwanele nolungenele ukumisa inani.
z-m-20-02.material: Ezinombolweni ezimbili zangempela a no-b, konke owaziyo ukuthi a+b=6. Akukho okusho ukuthi a no-b ziyizinombolo ezigcwele, futhi akukho okusho ukuthi zinhle. Sifuna ukubona ukuthi yiliphi amanani ezinkulumo esingawathola ngaphandle kokuthola a no-b ngokwehlukana. Ukufunda: a² ifundwa "a squared", ab "a times b", futhi a³ "a cubed".
z-m-20-02.thinking.1: Ukwenza wena izibonelo eziphikisayo (isamba esifanayo, amanani ahlukile)
z-m-20-02.thinking.2: Ukuqhathanisa ukuthi izingcezu zolwazi olwengeziwe zanele kangakanani
z-m-20-02.thinking.3: Ukuchaza isiphetho esinomqondo (isikwele simisiwe kodwa uphawu aluyimisiwe)
z-m-20-02.prereq.3: Isipiliyoni sokuguqula izinkulumo ngaphandle kokuthola amanani ezinombolo zangempela a no-b ngokwehlukana
z-m-20-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izinkulumo ezinenani limiswe libe linye ngenxa yeqiniso lokuthi a+b=6 kuphela.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kunkulumo ngayinye oyikhethayo, faka amabhangqa amabili ahlukile (a, b) afeza a+b=6 bese uqhathanisa ukuthi amanani ayafana yini.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ezinkulumweni lapho amanani efana, hlola ukuthi ungazihlanganisa yini ukuze a+b ivele enkulumweni njengoba injalo.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.a: Inani lingashintsha kuncike ekutheni a no-b zihlukanisa kanjani isamba, futhi awukuhloli lokho. Faka a=3, b=3 no-a=0, b=6 bese uqhathanisa.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.b: Lesi sinqumo sibona ukuthi isamba a+b siqukethwe enkulumweni njengocezu olulodwa.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.c: Noma ngesamba esifanayo, uphawu lomehluko lungashintsha kuncike ekutheni a inkulu noma b inkulu, futhi ushiye lokho.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.d: Lesi sinqumo sibone inkulumo njengomumo wefomula yokuphindaphinda.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.e: 2a+2b imisiwe kodwa a²+b² ayimisiwe, ngakho isamba naso asimisiwe. Ucabange ukuthi uma ingxenye eyodwa imisiwe, okuphelele kumisiwe.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.explain: 2a+2b=2(a+b)=12 futhi a²+2ab+b²=(a+b)²=36. a²+b² ingu-18 uma a=3, b=3 futhi ingu-36 uma a=0, b=6, ngakho ayimisiwe. a−b nayo ingu-2 uma a=4, b=2 futhi ingu-−2 uma a=2, b=4.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amabhangqa amathathu (a, b) ane-a+b=6 lapho amanani e-a²+b² onke ehlukile. (a, b) kanye (b, a) kubalwa njengebhangqa elifanayo.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ukhethe a, usethe b ibe ngu-6−a, bese ubala a²+b² ngqo.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ukubona ukuthi amanani ahlukile yini, khetha amanani ahlukile ka-a, njengo-0, 1, 2, bese uqhathanisa.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a+b akuyona u-6. Engeza izinombolo ezimbili bese uhlola.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.explain: Ku-(1, 5), a²+b²=26; ku-(2, 4), ingu-20; ku-(3, 3), ingu-18; futhi ku-(0, 6), ingu-36. Noma ngesamba esifanayo, amanani e-a²+b² ahlukile. (1, 5) kanye (5, 1) zinesikhathi se-a²+b² esifanayo, ngakho zibalwa njengesibonelo esifanayo.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.prompt: Ngaphezu kwa-a+b=6, yimuphi umbandela olandelayo ongamisa inani le-a²+b² libe linye? Khetha zonke ezanele. (a no-b ziyizinombolo zangempela)
z-m-20-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kokukhethwayo ngakunye, cabanga ukuthi lowo mbandela kanye no-a+b=6 ukuvumela yini ukuthola a, b, noma ab.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.hint.1: Ngombandela ongancishisi abangenela baba munye, hlola ukuthi amabhangqa amabili ane-a²+b² ehlukile (isibonelo, (1, 5) no-(2, 4)) womabili afeza lowo mbandela yini.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.a: Uma a iyinombolo egcwele, kusala amathuba amaningi, njengo-a=1 no-a=2, futhi awuhloli ukuthi inani limisiwe yini.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.b: Lesi sinqumo sibona ukuthi uma wazi kokubili isamba nomkhiqizo, ungakhuluma nge-a²+b² usebenzisa isamba nomkhiqizo.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.c: Umbandela wophawu unciphisa abangenela kodwa awubancishi baba munye. a=1, b=5 no-a=2, b=4 bobabili bahle.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.d: Lesi sinqumo sisebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi uma wazi a+b no-a−b, ungathola a no-b ngokwehlukana.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.e: Lesi sinqumo sibona ukuthi isamba samakhubhu nasso singavezwa ngesamba nomkhiqizo, ngakho umkhiqizo ab ungatholakala.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.explain: Uma ab=8, ngakho a²+b²=(a+b)²−2ab=36−16=20. Uma a−b=2, ngakho a=4 no-b=2, ngakho ingu-20. Kusuka ku-a³+b³=(a+b)³−3ab(a+b)=216−18ab=144, sithola ab=4, ngakho a²+b²=36−8=28. Umbandela onjengokuba yinombolo egcwele noma ukuba nhle unciphisa abangenela kuphela futhi awubancishi baba munye.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.prompt: Uma a+b=6 no-ab=8, umngane uthe, "a−b nayo imisiwe ibe nenani elilodwa." Uyavuma? Bhala impendulo yakho ngezizathu.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.hint.0: Thola izinombolo ezimbili ezithile isamba sazo singu-6 nomkhiqizo wazo ungu-8, bese ubala a−b.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi kwenzekani ku-a−b uma ushintshanisa amagama a no-b ezinombolweni ezimbili owathole.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ingabe unikeze isizathu ngokusho ukuthi (a−b)² iyini, noma ngokusebenzisa amabhangqa athile njengo-a=4, b=2 no-a=2, b=4?
z-m-20-02.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale ngokucacile ukuthi a−b ingaba namanani amabili (uphawu)?
z-m-20-02.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uhlukanise ukuthi isikwele (a−b)² simisiwe kodwa a−b ngokwayo ayimisiwe?
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.0: Angivumelani. (a−b)²=(a+b)²−4ab=36−32=4, ngakho a−b ingu-2 noma −2. Elinye lawo lincike ekulandelaneni kuka-a no-b, ngakho alimisiwe libe linye.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.1: Uma a=4, b=2, ngakho a−b=2, futhi uma a=2, b=4, ngakho a−b=−2, futhi kuwo womabili isamba singu-6 nomkhiqizo ungu-8. Ngakho a−b ayimisiwe ibe linye, futhi isikwele (a−b)²=4 kuphela simisiwe.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.2: Inani eliphelele elingu-2 kuphela elimisiwe. Noma isamba nomkhiqizo kufana, ukushintshanisa a no-b kushintsha uphawu lwa-a−b, ngakho −2 nakho kungenzeka, futhi akuyona inani elilodwa nje.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.3: Angivumelani. a−b ingu-2 noma −2. Kuphela (a−b)²=4 elinqunyiwe.

z-m-20-05.title: Singakwazi ini ngama-coefficient ngaphandle kokuwanwebisa?
z-m-20-05.topic: Ukuthola izamba zama-coefficient ngokufaka amanani ka-x
z-m-20-05.goal: Ngaphandle kokunwebisa isisho, hlukanisa ulwazi mayelana nama-coefficient ongalwazi emanani ku-x=0, 1, −1 nolwazi ongalwazi, uthole futhi ulungise iphutha esixazululweni, futhi ubonise ukuthi ama-polynomial amaningana anolwazi olufanayo.
z-m-20-05.material: Uma unwebisa ngokuphelele u-P(x)=(x²−x−1)³, kuba isisho sezinga lesi-6 esinamagama kusukela ku-x⁶ kuya egameni eliqhubekayo. Ukufunda: P(x) ngu-"x isikwele ukudonsa x ukudonsa u-1, ngaphakathi kwamabhrakhethi, kukhuphukele kuka-3". Sifuna ukuthola ulwazi mayelana nama-coefficient ngaphandle kokunwebisa. P(0), P(1), no-P(−1) kungatholakala kalula ngokufaka ngqo kumabhrakhethi. Sizobhala isisho esinwebisiwe njengo-P(x)=a₆x⁶+a₅x⁵+a₄x⁴+a₃x³+a₂x²+a₁x+a₀ (ukufunda: a₆ ngu-"a isithupha", futhi inombolo engezansi igama elibonisa izinga).
z-m-20-05.thinking.0: Ukuhumusha ukuthi inani elifakiwe liyi-combination yama-coefficient ayiphi
z-m-20-05.thinking.2: Ukuklama ama-polynomial amaningana anelisa imibandela efanayo
z-m-20-05.prereq.1: Incazelo yenani uma x=1, x=−1, x=0 kufakwa ku-polynomial (inani le-polynomial)
z-m-20-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha konke ongakuthola usebenzisa amanani amathathu kuphela P(0), P(1), P(−1) (ngaphandle kokunwebisa).
z-m-20-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi igama ngalinye aₖxᵏ liba yini uma ufaka u-0, 1, −1 ku-x, uhlukanisa icala lapho u-k eyi-even nalapho u-k eyi-odd.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kokukhethwayo ngakunye, bhala ukuthi yiyiphi i-combination yamanani amathathu P(0), P(1), P(−1) enika leli nani, futhi uma lingeke lichazwe, yenza isibonelo esiphikisayo nge-polynomial elula.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.a: Amanani amathathu ulwazi nje mayelana nezamba ezithile zama-coefficient. Awuhlolanga ukuthi i-coefficient yegama elilodwa ingaziwa ngokwehlukana yini.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.b: Lesi sahlulelo sibheka ukuthi yiliphi igama elisele uma ufaka u-0 ku-x.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.c: Lesi sahlulelo sibona ukuthi izimpawu zamagama ezinga le-odd zihluka kanjani ku-x=1 no-x=−1.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.o.d: I-coefficient a₆ ka-x⁶ (i-coefficient yegama elinezinga eliphezulu)
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.d: Ungasho igama elinezinga eliphezulu ngokubheka isakhiwo sesisho, kodwa lawa manani amathathu odwa awalimisi. Awuhlukanisanga ukuthi ulwazi luni inkinga eluvumelayo.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.e: Lesi sahlulelo sibona ukuthi uma ufaka u-x=1, wonke amandla ka-x aba ngu-1.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.explain: P(0)=a₀, P(1)=isamba sawo wonke ama-coefficient, no-P(1)−P(−1)=2(isamba sama-coefficient egama ezinga le-odd). I-coefficient a₃ yegama elilodwa noma i-coefficient a₆ yegama elinezinga eliphezulu ayimiswa yilawa manani amathathu odwa (uma ubheka isakhiwo ngqo, ungabona ukuthi a₆=1, kodwa lolo ulwazi olwehlukile).
z-m-20-05.s.s2.prompt: Umfundi uthole isamba sama-coefficient egama ezinga le-even nesamba sama-coefficient egama ezinga le-odd. Khetha umugqa owodwa onephutha.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.hint.0: Khipha isisho esinoku-x=−1 esifakiwe kusisho esinoku-x=1 esifakiwe, futhi ubheke ngqo ukuthi yimaphi amagama asalayo nokuthi yimaphi anyamalala.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.hint.1: Bheka ama-coefficient angaphambi kwamagama asele futhi uwaqhathanise nesamba ofuna ukusithola.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.line.3: Ukwengeza ama-equation amabili kunika 2(a₆+a₄+a₂+a₀)=0, ngakho isamba sama-coefficient egama ezinga le-even singu-0.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.line.4: Ukukhipha ama-equation amabili kunika ukuthi isamba sama-coefficient egama ezinga le-odd singu-(−1)−1=−2.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.explain: Umugqa 5 awulungile. Ukukhipha i-equation yesibili kweyokuqala kunika 2(a₅+a₃+a₁)=−1−1=−2, ngakho isamba sama-coefficient egama ezinga le-odd singu-−1. Imigqa 1 kuya ku-4 ilungile. Amagama ezinga le-even afaka igama eliqhubekayo a₀.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.prompt: Esishweni se-cubic u-Q(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d (a, b, c, d yizinombolo eziphelele, a≠0), yenza ama-Q amathathu ahlukene lapho isamba sawo wonke ama-coefficient singu-0 futhi isamba sama-coefficient egama ezinga le-odd singu-2.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ukhethe u-a ukuze isamba sama-coefficient amabili egama ezinga le-odd sibe ngu-2, bese ufanisa u-c.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.hint.1: Bese ubala ukuthi isamba sama-coefficient asele amabili u-b no-d kumele sibe yini ukuze isamba sawo wonke ama-coefficient sibe ngu-0.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.fail.c1: Uma u-a engu-0, akuyona i-cubic expression.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.fail.c2: Sicela uthathe wonke ama-coefficient njengezinombolo eziphelele.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.fail.c3: Isamba sawo wonke ama-coefficient asisona u-0.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.ok.c4: Isamba sama-coefficient egama ezinga le-odd singu-2.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.fail.c4: Isamba sama-coefficient egama ezinga le-odd (x³, x) asisona u-2.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.explain: Isibonelo, u-x³+x−2 unesamba se-coefficient esingu-1+1−2=0 futhi isamba se-coefficient ye-odd singu-1+1=2. U-2x³−x²−1 naye unesamba esingu-0 nesamba se-odd esingu-2. Kunama-cubic expression amaningana anezingcezu ezimbili ezifanayo zolwazi.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.prompt: Ama-Q ahlukene owawenza ku-s3 wonke anezingcezu ezimbili ezifanayo zolwazi (isamba se-coefficient 0, isamba se-odd 2). Bhala ukuthi kungani lezi zingcezu ezimbili zolwazi zodwa zingalimisi i-cubic expression ibe yinye, futhi uqagele futhi ubhale ukuthi yini enye ebizodingeka ukuyimisa ibe yinye.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.hint.0: Hlela etafuleni ukuthi yimaphi phakathi kuka-a, b, c, d ahluka phakathi kwama-Q owenzile.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.hint.1: Bala inani lama-coefficient nenani lama-equation avela kwimibandela emibili, futhi uqhathanise.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uqhathanise futhi wabhala ukuthi kunama-coefficient amangaki nezingcezu zolwazi (ama-equation) ezingaki?
z-m-20-05.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usebenzise ama-Q ahlukene owenzile njengobufakazi?
z-m-20-05.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uqambe ulwazi olwengeziwe oludingekayo ngesibonelo esiqondile (isibonelo, inani lika-Q(2) noma inani lika-a)?
z-m-20-05.s.s4.model.0: Kunama-coefficient amane a, b, c, d, kodwa kunama-equation amabili kuphela, a+b+c+d=0 no-a+c=2. Ngakho uma umisa u-a, u-c uyalandela, futhi u-b no-d kuphela isamba sabo esimisiwe, ngakho kungaba khona amaningi, njengo-x³+x−2 no-2x³−x²−1. Sidinga ama-equation amabili amaningi.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.model.1: Ulwazi luyizamba ezimbili, ngakho i-coefficient ngayinye ayimiswa. Isibonelo, uma a=1 khona-ke c=1, futhi uma a=2 khona-ke c=0, ngakho kuphuma izisho ezihlukile. Sidinga imibandela eminingi, njengenani lika-Q(2) noma inani lika-a, futhi ngisho nalapho kudingeka enye ukumisa u-b no-d.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.modelNote.1: Le mpendulo ikhuluma nokuthi isamba sika-b no-d kuphela esimisiwe.

z-m-20-03.prereq.0: I-H1 kulo msebenzi imaka kuphela ubunzima nezinga losizo lalesi sethi sokukhiqiza; akusona isikhundla sebanga ekharikhulamu. Cabanga ukuthi uyazi ukwengeza, ukukhipha nokuphindaphinda kwama-polynomial esikole esiphakathi, amafomula okuphindaphinda, nokwenza ama-factor okuyisisekelo.
z-m-20-03.title: Ukuklama inkulumo yedigri 4 engumkhiqizo wezinkulumo ezine eziqondile
z-m-20-03.topic: Ukuhlukanisa ngezici nokuklama izinkulumo zedigri 4 usebenzisa ukushintshanisa
z-m-20-03.goal: Qhathanisa izinhlelo zokuhlukanisa inkulumo yedigri 4 enocezu oluphindiwe, klama wena izinkulumo ezingumkhiqizo wezinkulumo ezine eziqondile, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani imibandela iyadingeka.
z-m-20-03.material: Inkulumo (x²+x)²−8(x²+x)+12 ingabhalwa njengomkhiqizo wezinkulumo ezine eziqondile ezine-coefficient ezigcwele (ukufunda: isikwele se-x squared plus x, kususwe izikhathi ezi-8 x squared plus x, kwengezwe 12). Kuvumelekile ukuthi inkulumo eqondile efanayo iphindwe. Phakathi kwezinkulumo ezifanayo (x²+x)²+m(x²+x)+n (m no-n ziyizinombolo ezigcwele), sifuna ukuthola ezinye ezingumkhiqizo wezinkulumo ezine eziqondile ezine-coefficient ezigcwele.
z-m-20-03.thinking.0: Ukukhetha ezisebenzayo phakathi kwezinhlelo zokuxazulula eziningana
z-m-20-03.thinking.2: Ukwenza isiphetho esibanzi nokuchaza umbandela wokuhlukanisa
z-m-20-03.prereq.1: Ukuhlukanisa ngezici izinkulumo ze-quadratic ezimumo x²+px+q (ucabanga ngesamba nomkhiqizo)
z-m-20-03.prereq.2: Isipiliyoni sokufaka isicucu ngohlamvu olulodwa ukubuka inkulumo
z-m-20-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izinhlelo ezingaqhutshwa kuze kube sekugcineni ukubhala inkulumo enikeziwe (x²+x)²−8(x²+x)+12 njengomkhiqizo wezinkulumo eziqondile ezine-coefficient ezigcwele.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.hint.0: Landela uhlelo ngalunye umugqa owodwa noma emibili bese uhlola ukuthi izinkulumo ezine eziqondile ziyavela ekugcineni.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.hint.1: Uma usebenzisa indlela yokufaka amanani ambalwa ukuhlola, cabanga ukuthi izinga lamanani ahloliwe lanele yini nokuthi kusitshela ini ukuthi u-0 awuvelanga.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.a: Faka izinombolo ezigcwele ezithile esikhundleni sika-x, futhi uma u-0 ungaveli, nquma ukuthi ayikwazi ukuhlukaniswa
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.a: Uphethe ngokuthi ayikwazi ukuhlukaniswa ngoba nje u-0 awuvelanga ngamanani ambalwa. Kungenzeka ushiye ongenela, noma ushiye ukuthi ingahlukaniswa ibe yizinkulumo ze-quadratic hhayi ezinhlangothini eziqondile.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.b: Shintshanisa x²+x ngohlamvu olulodwa bese uyihlukanisa njengenkulumo ye-quadratic, bese ubheka futhi izinkulumo ezimbili ezivelayo
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.b: Lolu uhlelo lokuphatha isicucu esiphindiwe njengesisodwa futhi uxazulule ngezinyathelo.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.c: Bhala (x−2)(x−6) bese uyinikeza njengempendulo ngaphandle kokubeka x²+x esikhundleni sika-x
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.c: Ushiye ukuthi x²+x kumele ibe endaweni yesicucu. Bheka ukuthi yiyiphi indawo okufanele ibuyiselwe ukuze inkulumo ye-quadratic ngohlamvu olulodwa ibe inkulumo efanayo neyokuqala.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.d: Nweba onke amabhulakethe abe yinkulumo yedigri 4, bese ufaka abahlukanisi ba-12 uqale ngalabo abanikeza u-0
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.d: Lolu uhlelo lokuhlola ngokucophelela abangenela bezici enkulumweni enwetshiwe.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.explain: Kokubili b no-d kungaqhutshwa kuze kube sekugcineni. b ihlukana ibe into efana no-(A−2)(A−6), bese ibuyisela A=x²+x futhi ihlukana futhi, no-d iyixazulula njengenkulumo yedigri 4 futhi ithola izici linye ngalinye ngethiyori yesici. a ayihloli bonke abangenela, no-c ayibuyiselanga uhlamvu.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.prompt: Thola amabhangqa amabili ahlukile ezinombolo ezigcwele (m, n) lapho (x²+x)²+m(x²+x)+n iyimkhiqizo wezinkulumo ezine eziqondile ezine-coefficient ezigcwele. Kodwa, n ayingu-0, futhi ungafaki (m, n)=(−8, 12) engenhla.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.hint.0: Phatha x²+x njengohlamvu olulodwa, khetha p no-q ukuze ithathe uhlobo (uhlamvu −p)(uhlamvu −q), bese uthola m=−(p+q) no-n=pq.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kwa-p no-q owazikhethile, hlola ngokwehlukana ukuthi x²+x−p no-x²+x−q ngamunye uhlukana ube yizinkulumo ezimbili eziqondile ezine-coefficient ezigcwele yini.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Sicela uthathe m no-n njengezinombolo ezigcwele.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Inkulumo ye-quadratic ephatha x²+x njengohlamvu olulodwa ifeza umbandela we-discriminant wokuba nezimpande ezigcwele.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Inkulumo ye-quadratic ephatha x²+x njengohlamvu olulodwa ayihlukani ibe yizinkulumo ezimbili eziqondile ezine-coefficient ezigcwele.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Leyo nkulumo ye-quadratic ihlukana ibe yizinkulumo ezimbili ezine-coefficient ezigcwele.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Leyo nkulumo ye-quadratic ayihlukani ibe yizinkulumo ezimbili ezine-coefficient ezigcwele.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Izinkulumo ezimbili ezihlukanisiwe zihlukana futhi zibe yizinkulumo eziqondile ezine-coefficient ezigcwele.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Okungenani eyodwa yezinkulumo ezimbili zokuhlukanisa kokuqala ayihlukani futhi ibe yizinkulumo ezimbili eziqondile ezine-coefficient ezigcwele.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, uma (m, n)=(−14, 24), ngakho (x²+x−2)(x²+x−12)=(x+2)(x−1)(x+4)(x−3), futhi uma (−18, 72), ngakho (x²+x−6)(x²+x−12)=(x+3)(x−2)(x+4)(x−3). Uma (−4, 4), ngakho (x²+x−2)²=(x+2)²(x−1)². (−5, 6) ihlukana ibe (x²+x−2)(x²+x−3), kodwa x²+x−3 ayihlukani futhi ibe yizinkulumo eziqondile ezine-coefficient ezigcwele.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.prompt: Uma (m, n)=(−4, 3), ihlukana ibe (x²+x−3)(x²+x−1). Ingabe x²+x−3 kulezi ihlukana futhi ibe ngumkhiqizo wezinkulumo ezimbili eziqondile ezine-coefficient ezigcwele? Phendula "iyahlukana" noma "ayihlukani" bese ubhala isizathu.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.hint.0: Yeka x²+x−3=(x+u)(x+v) bese ubhala ukuthi i-coefficient ye-x negama eliqondile liphuma kanjani nge-u no-v uma unweba uhlangothi lwesokudla.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala phansi wonke amabhangqa ezinombolo ezigcwele umkhiqizo wawo ungu-−3, uthole isamba sebhangqa ngalinye, bese uhlola ukuthi noma yisiphi sazo singu-1.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ukuthi u+v no-uv kumele ngamunye kube yini uma kubhalwe ngomumo (x+u)(x+v)?
z-m-20-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale ukuthi ufune izinombolo ezigcwele u no-v ezinjalo (noma unikeze esinye isizathu, njenge-discriminant)?
z-m-20-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usho ukuthi isiphetho esithi "ayisebenzi" sivela ekuhloleni abangenela abaningi noma kumbandela othile?
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.0: Ayihlukani. Uma siyibhala njenge-(x+u)(x+v), sidinga u+v=1 no-uv=−3, kodwa amabhangqa ezinombolo ezigcwele anomkhiqizo −3 ngu-(1, −3) no-(−1, 3) kuphela, futhi izamba zawo ziyi-−2 no-2, ngakho asikwazi ukuthola u-1.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.1: Ayihlukani futhi nge-coefficient ezigcwele. I-discriminant ye-x²+x−3=0 ingu-1+12=13, futhi u-13 akuyona isikwele esiphelele, ngakho izimpande aziyizinombolo ezigcwele noma izingxenye, bese ayikwazi ukubhalwa njengomkhiqizo wezinkulumo ezimbili eziqondile ezine-coefficient ezigcwele.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.2: Uma p=2, kukhona u=2 no-v=−1 onesamba esingu-1 nomkhiqizo −2, ngakho iyahlukana. Kodwa ku-3, awukho umbhangqa wezinombolo ezigcwele onomkhiqizo −3 nesamba 1, ngakho ayihlukani. Ngakho kubonakala ukuthi p kumele ibe ngumkhiqizo wezinombolo ezimbili ezilandelanayo, njengo-2, 6, 12, ukuze ihlukane.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.3: Ayihlukaniseki. Ukufaka abahlukanisi bamagama ahlala njalo −3, 1, −1, 3, −3, akunikezi u-0.

z-m-20-04.prereq.0: I-H1 kulo msebenzi imaka kuphela ubunzima nezinga losizo lalesi sethi sokukhiqiza; akusona isikhundla sebanga ekharikhulamu. z-m-20-04.title: Ingabe inani lenkulumo efakwe inombolo engenaso isilinganiso liyinombolo engenaso isilinganiso?
z-m-20-04.topic: Inani nesisele senkulumo efakwe inombolo engenaso isilinganiso
z-m-20-04.goal: Hlola ngokubala ukuthi inani lenkulumo ye-cubic efakwe inombolo engenaso isilinganiso lingaba inombolo egcwele, bese wenza enye inkulumo enenani elingu-4 ngesizathu esifanayo.
z-m-20-04.material: Sifuna ukuthola inani le-E=x³−3x²−3x+5 uma x=2+√3. Ukufunda: x ngu-"2 plus root 3" futhi x³ ngu-"x cubed". Asisebenzisi i-calculator. √3 yinombolo enhle isikwele sayo singu-3, futhi ayikwazi ukubhalwa njengengxenye. Ulwazi lwembulwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi, ngakho isikhathi ngasinye khetha lokho ocabanga ukuthi kufaneleka kakhulu manje.
z-m-20-04.thinking.0: Ukulungisa umcabango wakho wangaphambi kokubala isikhathi ngasinye lapho kuvela ulwazi olwengeziwe
z-m-20-04.prereq.1: Iqiniso lokuthi √3×√3=3 nokuthi √3 ayikwazi ukubhalwa njengengxenye
z-m-20-04.prereq.3: Incazelo yomphumela wokuhlukanisa nesisele lapho i-polynomial ihlukaniswa nge-polynomial (inkulumo yokuhlukanisa A=BQ+R)
z-m-20-04.s.s1.prompt: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho ulwazi lwembulwa, khetha ocabanga ngenani le-E.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, bhala ukuthi ungaya kude kangakanani ngokubala okwaziwayo kuze kube manje kuphela.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola izitatimende ezine-"kumele" noma "akukho nanini" phakathi kokukhethwayo usebenzisa izibonelo eziphikisayo noma ukubala.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.info: x yinombolo engenaso isilinganiso 2+√3, futhi i-E inamagama lapho x iphindaphindwa izikhathi eziningana (x³, x²). Konke osukubalile kuze kube manje ukuthi x²=(2+√3)²=7+4√3.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ucabanga ukuthi inani le-E lizothatha mumo muni?
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ungenza umcabango, kodwa awunaso isisekelo sokusho ukuthi kumele kube ngenaso isilinganiso. Uma ubala kuze kube ngu-x³, uzokwazi ukusho.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Njengoba x ingenaso isilinganiso, cishe ngiqinisekile ukuthi i-E nayo ayinaso isilinganiso.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uma ubala ngezinombolo ezingenaso isilinganiso, √3 ingasuka. Isibonelo, (1+√3)+(1−√3)=2. Kusenesikhathi sokusho "kumele" ngaphambi kokubala.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kubonakala kungenzeka ukuthi ayinaso isilinganiso, kodwa siyazi ngokuqinisekile kuphela ngemva kokubala kuze kube ngu-x³.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wenze umcabango futhi wacabanga nangesidingo sokuwuhlola.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Zonke i-coefficient zenkulumo ziyizinombolo ezigcwele, ngakho i-E iyinombolo egcwele ngisho nangaphandle kokubala.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Iqiniso lokuthi i-coefficient ziyizinombolo ezigcwele alinikezi isiphetho esifanayo nalapho x iyinombolo egcwele.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ngazi kuphela x², ngakho x³ inzima ukuyithola, futhi ngicabanga ukuthi akukho okungasho okwamanje.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ungaqhubeka nge-x³=x²×x. Ungaqhubeka nokubala ngolwazi olunalo manje.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.info: x³=x²×x=(7+4√3)(2+√3)=26+15√3. Faka x²=7+4√3, x=2+√3, x³=26+15√3 ku-E=x³−3x²−3x+5, bese uqoqa ingxenye egcwele ne-coefficient ye-√3 ngokwehlukana.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Ingxenye egcwele ingu-26−21−6+5=4 futhi i-coefficient ye-√3 ingu-15−12−3=0. Ngakho E=4. Noma ufaka inombolo engenaso isilinganiso x, inani lingaba yinombolo egcwele, futhi uma ucabange ekuqaleni "kungenzeka ayinaso isilinganiso", udinga ukulungisa lowo mcabango.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: I-coefficient ye-√3 iba ngu-15−12−3=0, ngakho E iyinombolo egcwele engu-4.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Lesi sinqumo sivela ekuqoqeni izingxenye ezimbili ngokwehlukana.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Igama le-√3 lisala, ngakho E ayinaso isilinganiso.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Awuqoqanga zonke i-coefficient zamagama e-√3 futhi ubheke u-15 kuphela. Bala 15−12−3.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: I-coefficient ye-√3 ingu-0, ngakho yonke i-E ingu-0.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Igama le-√3 ukunyamalala kuhlukile ekutheni ingxenye egcwele ibe ngu-0. Bala nengxenye egcwele 26−21−6+5.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Njengoba x ingenaso isilinganiso, nalo mphumela wokubala awukwazi ukwethenjwa.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ukubala okufakwe inombolo engenaso isilinganiso nakho kunembile. Umphumela ongunombolo egcwele awusho ukuthi awulungile.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.info: x=2+√3 ifeza x²−4x+1=0 (x²=7+4√3 futhi 4x=8+4√3, ngakho x²−4x+1=0). Futhi, uma E ihlukaniswa ngo-x²−4x+1, umphumela wokuhlukanisa ungu-x+1 nesisele singu-4, ngakho E=(x+1)(x²−4x+1)+4 iyasebenza.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Linini inani uma ufaka x=2−√3 ku-E? (2−√3 nayo ifeza x²−4x+1=0. Ungahlola futhi ngokufaka ngqo.)
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Uma x²−4x+1=0 isebenza, ngakho E=(x+1)×0+4=4. 2−√3 ifeza isibalo esifanayo, ngakho inani lifana. Uma ufaka ngqo, uthola no-4.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Uphawu lwa-√3 lushintshile, ngakho uphawu lwengxenye egcwele luzoshintsha nalo futhi luzoba ngu-−4.
